description: Deterministic half of the weekly cold-pitch sweep: finds every sender who has pitched three or more times with no reply ever, excludes the owner's own addresses (worked out from their sent mail), platform automation and anyone with a real relationship on file, and writes a plain digest to /me/autopilot/cold-pitch-sweep/<date>-senders.md. Writes no message and sends nothing.
name: cold_pitch_senders
